description:
Minimum 6+ Years of experience in web application design and development.
Self-motivated and pro-active with demonstrated problem solving and critical thinking skills.
Expertise in enterprise Java technology eco-system including Spring Boot, JPA/Spring Data, maven, JUnit.
Expertise on core JavaScript and front-end frameworks such as AngularJS.
Experience with micro-services architecture, Docker eco-system and API first approach with hands-on expertise in developing rest APIs supporting multiple versions
Experience with relational databases, data modeling and SQL optimization
Knowledge of different caching strategies, performance tuning, transaction management across systems and messaging systems
Should have good knowledge of Agile/Scrum, continuous integration and deployment
Hands-on experience in server side JS technologies such as nodeJS is a big plus.



 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
